title.narrative: Coastal Economic Development in Kenya (Partnership between the EU and the Government of Kenya to advance the Blue Economy Agenda through Coastal Development - ʺGo Blueʺ)

description.narrative: This Description of the Action defines the activities entrusted to GIZ to strengthen blue economy value chains, mainly through the provision of skills development and support to value chain development in selected blue economy value chains. The geographical scope of the project is limited to the Coastal Counties Economic Block, in particular the counties of Kilifi, Kwale, Lamu, Mombasa, Taita Taveta and Tana River. This project is being undertaken as one component of the European Union (EU) Coastal Economic Development in Kenya Action (the EU Action), financed under the 11th European Development Fund (EDF). The EU Action is based on a partnership between the EU and the Government of Kenya (GoK) to advance the Blue Economy Agenda through coastal development - Go Blue.
